title: Brb booking a trip up to Boston immediately- and you should too! #New...
transcript: Y'all listen up because my favorite show that I saw on the West End this past summer is finally coming to the United States, and you have to go see it. This is not sponsored. They are not paying me or asking me to post this. I am posting this of my own accord, just cause I really love the show and I think that more people need to know about it and go see it. As you may have guessed from the text below me, it is called Two Strangers Carry a Cake Across New York. And yes, it's a bad title, but it's a really good show. I promise. This is one of those shows where describing the plot doesn't really do it justice, but I will try my best. The show is very much romcom vibes. You have a British guy visiting New York City for the first time. Everything in the city is amazing. He's so happy to be here. And then you have a girl who is a native New Yorker, she's an American, and she's very jaded by the city and life in general. And of course, these personalities at first really clash with each other. But over the course of the show, they learn to see and understand each other and, you know, maybe fall in love. The show is so cute and the music is so catchy. There's actually a cast album that you can listen to right now on Spotify with all of the music. So you can check it out or you can choose to go in blind. Regardless, the show will be playing the American Repertory Theater up in Cambridge, which is right outside of Boston. So if this sounds even remotely up your alley, definitely consider checking it out because I personally really loved it.
reasoning: Creator explicitly calls it their favorite West End show of the summer, unprompted endorsement, praises music and story, and directly urges viewers to see it.
